title: The Best Matter Ceiling Fans
subtitle: Smart ceiling fans that work across every major smart home system, ranked.
intro: We pulled the ceiling fans on Amazon whose listings name Matter support and scored them on rating, review volume, and features.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

buyers_guide.q: Smart ceiling fan or a smart fan control?
buyers_guide.a: A smart fan has Wi-Fi in the motor and light, so you get app control, schedules, and voice control without changing your wall switch. A smart wall control makes an existing fan smart without replacing it.

buyers_guide.q: Do smart ceiling fans need a hub?
buyers_guide.a: Most connect over Wi-Fi to the maker's app and work with Alexa and Google. Some use Bluetooth for setup.

buyers_guide.q: What size fan do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Roughly 42-48 inches for a bedroom up to 150 square feet, 52 inches for a typical living room, and 60 inches or more for large open rooms.

notes: Prices, ratings, and review counts refreshed from Amazon.
